The description is thorough enough to implement the function faithfully.

incorrect_or_misleading_points: The description says 'while still returning the parsed declaration node' after the using/await using error, which is correct, but it could be read as implying execution continues to the declarator loop — it does not, since there is an explicit return after raiseOverwrite.
